style.backgroundSystem: white base with soft sky-blue watercolor wave bands and organic cloud shapes as section dividers
style.iconSystem: soft round bubble badges, brush-stroke label swipes, thin dashed doodle connectors
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key soft studio light, gentle front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh contrast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh pet-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft sky-blue watercolor bands #BFDFF0, deep ocean-blue text #1E6FA8, and bright sky-blue accent #4FA3D9; cool tone; rounded bold sans-serif headlines only; watercolor wave and cloud shaped section dividers; soft round bubble badges, brush-stroke label swipes and thin dashed doodle connectors; bright high-key soft studio lighting with soft contact shadows; clean white matte surfaces; stable upright product scale with balanced airy compositions; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product tube upright at a slight 3/4 angle as the recurring hero angle, stable scale across the set, balanced airy compositions
style.typography: rounded bold sans-serif headlines, no serif or handwriting mixing
